description: This file defines the ApiCallMonitoringMiddleware class, which extends AbstractMonitoringMiddleware to implement API call monitoring within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for wrapping middleware, processing request and response data, and retrieving information about API call attempts, errors, and retries.

classes.name: ApiCallMonitoringMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for monitoring API call metrics and handling retry and error tracking within AWS SDK requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware handler wrapped with CSM options, returning a closure for use in the SDK handler stack.

methods.name: getRequestData
methods.description: Returns an empty array with request-specific data for monitoring purposes.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Gets data about the response, including attempt count, max retries, and final attempt data, depending on whether the response is a result or exception.

methods.name: getResultAttemptCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of attempts made for a given ResultInterface by counting transfer stats.

methods.name: getExceptionAttemptCount
methods.description: Counts the number of attempts associated with a monitoring event if an exception implements MonitoringEventsInterface.

methods.name: getFinalAttemptData
methods.description: Retrieves key information about the final attempt made during an API call, matched via event keys.

methods.name: getFinalAttempt
methods.description: Finds the last monitoring event of type 'ApiCallAttempt' in an array of events.

methods.name: getMaxRetriesExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the exception signifies that the maximum retries have been exceeded.

methods.name: populateRequestEventData
methods.description: Adds metadata to the request event, setting its type to 'ApiCall'.

methods.name: populateResultEventData
methods.description: Adds latency information to the result event based on timestamps.

search-terms: AWS SDK PHP API call monitoring
